name: worktree-control
description: Local control plane that moves development servers between Git worktrees on stable ports
author: pioootrek

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "console.error('Refusing npm publish from a checkout: it would pack unverified local dist/out without the fingerprint, clean-tree, checksum and provenance checks. Publish the CI tarball instead; see docs/package-trial.md (Publish a release).'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.build: next build && tsup src/cli/index.ts src/cli/backup-verifier.ts src/cli/godot-web-server.ts --format esm --platform node --target node22 --clean --out-dir dist/cli && node scripts/build-fingerprint.mjs --write
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:resources
scripts.test:e2e:godot-web: node scripts/build-fingerprint.mjs --check && playwright test --config playwright.e2e.config.ts tests/e2e/godot-web-live-reload.spec.ts
scripts.test:backups: vitest run src/server/modules/backups src/cli/backup-policy-options.test.ts src/server/backup-admin.test.ts src/server/transports/backup-http.test.ts src/server/control-service-storage.test.ts
scripts.test:integration:backup-monitor: node scripts/build-fingerprint.mjs --check && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/backup-monitor.test.ts
scripts.test:integration:remote-backups: node scripts/build-fingerprint.mjs --check && node scripts/require-restic-fixture.mjs && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/remote-backups.test.ts tests/integration/backup-operations.test.ts tests/integration/user-backups.test.ts
scripts.test:integration:remote-rebind: node scripts/build-fingerprint.mjs --check && node scripts/require-restic-fixture.mjs && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/remote-rebind.test.ts
scripts.test:package:remote-rebind: node scripts/build-fingerprint.mjs --check && node scripts/require-restic-fixture.mjs && node scripts/package-smoke.mjs --verification-script scripts/package-remote-rebind.mjs
scripts.test:package:tools: node scripts/build-fingerprint.mjs --check && node --test scripts/package-artifact.test.mjs scripts/package-install.test.mjs scripts/package-lifecycle-trial.test.mjs scripts/provider-release.test.mjs
scripts.test:service-safety: vitest run src/cli/service-options.test.ts src/cli/service-install.test.ts src/cli/service-manager.test.ts src/cli/systemd-drop-ins.test.ts src/cli/backup-management.test.ts
scripts.test:integration:service-safety: node scripts/build-fingerprint.mjs --check && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/service-safety.test.ts tests/integration/backup-operations.test.ts
scripts.test:mcp-diagnostics: vitest run src/server/mcp-diagnostics-http.test.ts src/features/mcp/session-summary.test.ts src/server/mcp-diagnostics.test.ts src/server/mcp-http-server.test.ts src/server/modules/mcp-sessions src/server/transports/mcp src/cli/mcp-session-options.test.ts src/server/admin-socket.test.ts src/server/modules/status/status-service.test.ts

scripts.test:dev-vault: vitest run src/server/modules/dev-vault src/server/infrastructure/dev-vault src/server/infrastructure/sqlite/dev-vault-queries.test.ts src/server/infrastructure/sqlite/dev-vault-migration.test.ts src/server/dev-vault-transports.test.ts src/cli/dev-vault.test.ts src/features/dev-vault src/architecture.test.ts
scripts.test:pr117-followup: vitest run src/server/authentication-provider-configuration.test.ts src/server/database-admission-completion.test.ts && vitest run --config vitest.auth-provider-proof.config.ts pr117-followup human-account-administration lifecycle-admission remote-admission
scripts.test:auth-provider-recovery: vitest run src/cli/auth-provider-input.test.ts src/server/modules/authentication/account-protection.test.ts && vitest run --config vitest.auth-provider-proof.config.ts protected-recovery human-account-administration cli-provider-administration cli-provider-lifecycle integrated-factor-authority lifecycle-admission session-issuance issuance-lifecycle runtime-reader runtime-mutate runtime-verification runtime-configuration

scripts.test:runtime-mutations: vitest run --maxWorkers 1 src/server/infrastructure/sqlite/human-runtime-migration.test.ts src/server/infrastructure/sqlite/runtime-membership-queries.test.ts src/server/infrastructure/sqlite/runtime-membership-migration.test.ts src/server/modules/authorization/policy.test.ts src/cli/auth-provider-input.test.ts src/server/transports/authentication-http.test.ts && vitest run --config vitest.auth-provider-proof.config.ts runtime-mutate runtime-reader

scripts.test:rbac-artifact: node scripts/build-fingerprint.mjs --check && node scripts/package-provider.mjs && node scripts/package-rbac.mjs --baseline public-0.1.1 --provider-dir dist/provider-release
scripts.test:rbac-artifact:fresh: node scripts/build-fingerprint.mjs --check && node scripts/package-provider.mjs && node scripts/package-rbac.mjs --baseline fresh --provider-dir dist/provider-release
scripts.test:rbac-followup: vitest run --config vitest.auth-provider-proof.config.ts browser-authentication.test browser-factor-authentication.test provider-authorization.test mcp-admission.test production-composition
